svg.text: HR-V0 hard-stop region evidence and acquisition boundary
HR-V0-STOP-REGION-P0.1 / PRELIMINARY - NOMINAL CAD EVIDENCE ONLY - NO STOP OR MOTION RELEASE
What the nominal CAD now establishes
J1 candidate regions screened continuously: -25..-20 deg and 70..75 deg
J2 candidate region screened continuously: 10..15 deg
What remains physically unknown
• received horn/idler and frame axial stack
• approved fixed and moving attachment features
• side-plate, tool, cable and guard swept volumes
• stop material, bumper, retention and contact radius
• stopping travel, backlash, compliance and uncertainty
• impact, fatigue, prying, fastener and parent-load proof
No topology or stop angle is released.
Fail-closed next action
1. Receive and identify the exact J1/J2 actuator, H101, S102 and current custom-adapter articles.
2. Execute HSI-001..020 with calibrated instruments; preserve raw scans, uncertainty and photographs.
3. Select one topology only after attachment and swept-volume evidence is complete.
4. Generate integrated stop CAD, drawings, tolerance/load analysis and a guarded single-axis test article.
5. Measure contact, coast, stopping overtravel, impact and post-test condition before requesting motion credit.
Do not order, fabricate, connect, move or energize from this diagram.
